description: Per-character and per-shikigami jump/fall tuning: rise speed interpolation, held-jump overtime, air drift and turning, gravity/fall curves, inertia inheritance and carry, bounce-up motion, jump-transition rigidity, and the timing gates on air-jump cancel and ground-jump requests.

BounceUp_Blend_Exp.simple: Blend exponent for the bounce-up horizontal-speed interpolation.
BounceUp_Blend_Exp.technical: FloatInterp28.Start BlendExp argument in mode 36. C++ default 0.0f; all 49 exports use 2.0.

BounceUp_EasingType.simple: Easing enum for the bounce-up horizontal-speed interpolation.
BounceUp_EasingType.technical: EGameEasingType converted by ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc for the mode-36 FloatInterp28.Start. C++ constructor default EGameEasingType::None and all 49 exports are None. ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc maps None (and any unrecognized value) to EEasingFunc::EaseOut, so the exported None values are not a no-easing mode.

BounceUp_Inertia_Rate.simple: Inertia rate inherited from a previous bounce-up action.
BounceUp_Inertia_Rate.technical: ApplyPrevInertia and BlendInertiaFromAction select BounceUp_Inertia_Rate/Time for action type BounceUp. C++ default 0.0f; all 49 exports use 0.5.

BounceUp_Inertia_Time.simple: Inertia duration inherited from a previous bounce-up action.
BounceUp_Inertia_Time.technical: Seconds passed as the SetInertia/BlendInertia time in the BounceUp action-type arms. C++ default 0.0f; all 49 exports use 0.01.

BounceUp_InterpolateTime.simple: Duration of the bounce-up horizontal-speed interpolation.
BounceUp_InterpolateTime.technical: Seconds passed to FloatInterp28.Start in mode 36. C++ default 0.0f; all 49 exports use 0.5.

BounceUp_Speed_Start.simple: Initial upward speed of a bounce-up.
BounceUp_Speed_Start.technical: World units/s. SetMoveMode mode 36 sets MoveState.VerticalSpeed to this value and builds the fall curve from it using Fall_Gravity and the global JumpFall_Speed_Max; BounceUp::Start selects mode 36. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 1000 except CN_120 at 800.

BounceUp_XY_Speed_End.simple: Ending horizontal speed of a bounce-up.
BounceUp_XY_Speed_End.technical: World units/s passed as the FloatInterp28 To value in mode 36. C++ default 0.0f; all 49 exports use 500.

BounceUp_XY_Speed_Start.simple: Starting horizontal speed of a bounce-up.
BounceUp_XY_Speed_Start.technical: World units/s. Mode 36 starts MoveState.FloatInterp28 from this value toward BounceUp_XY_Speed_End. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 1500 except CN_120 at 1200.

DashJump_Blend_Exp.simple: Blend exponent for the DashJump vertical-speed interpolation.
DashJump_Blend_Exp.technical: FloatInterp Start BlendExp argument (the easing type is hardcoded EaseOut in these jump presets). C++ default 0.0f; exports are 2.0 in 48 rows and 0.8 in CP_180.

DashJump_Inertia_Rate.simple: Inertia rate inherited from a previous DashJump action.
DashJump_Inertia_Rate.technical: When the previous action type is DashJump, FGameCharacterAction::ApplyPrevInertia calls SetInertia with this rate/time pair; BlendInertiaFromAction uses the same pair through BlendInertia. FGameShikigamiAction::ApplyPrevInertia mirrors this for shikigami. No EaseOut override is row-driven. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.8 or 1.0.

DashJump_Inertia_Time.simple: Inertia duration inherited from a previous DashJump action.
DashJump_Inertia_Time.technical: Seconds passed as the easing time of SetInertia/BlendInertia in the character and shikigami previous-inertia paths for action type DashJump. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.1 (0.4/0.5 in two rows).

DashJump_Inherit_Inertia_Rate.simple: Horizontal inertia multiplier retained when entering DashJump.
DashJump_Inherit_Inertia_Rate.technical: ScaleInertia multiplies the currently active XY inertia interpolator current value by this rate at DashJumpBegin::Start, preserving its remaining duration/easing. StartJumpInertiaCarry also uses it when leaving jump mode 30 for a fall: it starts FloatInterp6D8 from Rate * FallVerticalSpeed to 0 over the Z/RateZ field when both Rate and Z are positive, otherwise it clears carry. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 1.0 in 48 rows and 0.8 in CP_180.

DashJump_Inherit_Inertia_RateZ.simple: Z/inertia-pair parameter retained when entering DashJump.
DashJump_Inherit_Inertia_RateZ.technical: ScaleInertia multiplies the active Z inertia interpolator current by this value (a ratio, not a time) at DashJumpBegin::Start. In StartJumpInertiaCarry the same field is instead passed as the FloatInterp6D8 duration in seconds despite its RateZ name. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.01 in 48 rows and 1.5 in CP_180.

DashJump_InterpolateTime.simple: Duration of the DashJump vertical-speed interpolation.
DashJump_InterpolateTime.technical: Seconds. Passed as the time argument of FloatInterp28.Start in character mode 22 and FloatInterp650.Start in character mode 30, with a hardcoded EaseOut; shikigami mode 9 uses the same EaseOut conversion. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.3 in 46 rows, 0.15 in CP_100/CP_130 and 0.8 in CP_180 (CP_010 is 0.3).

DashJump_Overtime.simple: How long a held dash jump continues to rise.
DashJump_Overtime.technical: Seconds; same TickJumpVertical held-key rule for character mode 0x16 and shikigami mode 9. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.035 in 47 rows and 0.07 in two rows.

DashJump_Rotation_Speed.simple: Yaw turn-rate cap for a dash jump in the air.
DashJump_Rotation_Speed.technical: Degrees/s passed through TickForwardAirMove/TurnYawToward for character modes 0x16/0x17 and through shikigami TickJumpAirMove for mode 9/10 sustain; <=0 snaps. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 180 in 48 rows and 100 in one.

DashJump_Speed_End.simple: Target vertical speed at the end of the DashJump rise interpolation.
DashJump_Speed_End.technical: World units/s. Used as the FloatInterp28 (and FloatInterp650 where present) To value with the same GetJumpPowerRate() scaling for characters and the raw value for shikigami. It is an interpolation target, not a persistent speed cap; the fall curve is built when the rise ends. C++ default 0.0f; CP_010 exports 4000.

DashJump_Speed_Start.simple: Initial vertical speed of the DashJump rise.
DashJump_Speed_Start.technical: World units/s (cm/s-like). Character SetMoveMode mode 22 starts MoveState.FloatInterp28 from GetJumpPowerRate() * this value and seeds MoveState.VerticalSpeed with the same scaled start; modes 30 start FloatInterp650 from the same scaled endpoints without resetting VerticalSpeed. Shikigami mode 9 uses the raw value for both roles (no power-rate multiplier). C++ default 0.0f; CP_010 exports 2000.

DashJump_XY_Speed.simple: Horizontal air speed for a dash jump.
DashJump_XY_Speed.technical: World units/s. TickForwardAirMove moves along owner forward in modes 0x16/0x17 with GetMoveSpeed scaling; shikigami mode 9/10 sustain uses the same row value. C++ default 0.0f; exports range 800-1400, CP_010 975.

Fall_Gravity.simple: Positive gravity magnitude used to build and hold fall curves.
Fall_Gravity.technical: World units/s^2. BuildFallCurve subtracts Time * Gravity from vertical speed (clamped by a global max or, on the character fall-transition path, Fall_XY_Speed); it is consumed at the rise apex, in fall modes 0x12-0x1B/0x22-0x25, in bounce-up and in shikigami fall/rise ticks. Character jump/fall modes multiply it by GetFallGravityRate() before building the curve; shikigami TickJumpVertical uses the raw row value. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 120 in 41 rows, 0 in CN_010/CN_040/CN_220, 110 in CP_100/CP_130, 130 in CP_200, 80 in CP_081 and 10 in CP_180. A zero value makes BuildFallCurve add no post-start keys and set EndSpeed to the starting speed, so the sampled curve stays at its start speed.

Fall_Rotation_Speed.simple: Yaw turn-rate cap while drifting in a fall.
Fall_Rotation_Speed.technical: Degrees/s passed to TurnYawToward in character mode 0x21 and in shikigami follow-fall. TurnYawToward snaps to the desired yaw when Rate <= 0 and otherwise limits each tick to Step * Rate degrees. C++ default 0.0f; all 49 exports use 400.

Fall_Speed_Start.simple: Positive starting downward speed used when a fall begins.
Fall_Speed_Start.technical: World units/s (cm/s-like). Character SetMoveMode fall entry and RestartFall set VerticalSpeed = -Fall_Speed_Start before BuildFallCurve; normal-dash air and homing follow-ground use the same negation, and shikigami modes 6/17 do the same on their own row. C++ constructor default is 0.0f; exported values are 500 for 47 rows, 350 for CP_040 and 200 for CP_180.

Fall_XY_Speed.technical: World units/s. TickModeFall moves along stick input at this speed only when input magnitude is nonzero, then applies GetMoveSpeed target/foreground/parallel-attack and MoveSpeedRate scaling; shikigami TickModeFollowFall uses it for follow-direction drift. Unusually, the character SetMoveMode fall transition also passes Fall_XY_Speed as BuildFallCurve MaxFallSpeed, so it bounds the sampled vertical curve in that path. C++ default 0.0f; exports range 350-600 (CP_010 500).

ID.simple: Exported row key (native FName Id), normally a character or shikigami ID.
ID.technical: The five exported assets ActionJumpDataTable1..5 are registered into the single ActionJumpDataTables cache; the export carries this key as ID while the reconstructed USTRUCT property is Id. AGameCharacter::ResolveDataRows first selects the Action row using the character setup's ActionIdOverride when non-None, then finds that Action row's Id_ActionJump and caches the result in ActionJumpRow; AGameShikigami::ResolveRows finds ShikigamiDataTable.Id_ActionJump only when it is not None. A None shikigami ID skips jump-row resolution, while a non-None lookup failure returns false and leaves the previous JumpRow unchanged. All 49 exported keys are referenced by at least one ActionDataTable or ShikigamiDataTable row; duplicate keys are absent.

Jump_Blend_Exp.simple: Blend exponent for the Jump vertical-speed interpolation.
Jump_Blend_Exp.technical: FloatInterp Start BlendExp argument (the easing type is hardcoded EaseOut in these jump presets). C++ default 0.0f; exports are 2.0 in 48 rows and 1.0 in CP_180.

Jump_Inertia_Rate.simple: Inertia rate inherited from a previous Jump action.
Jump_Inertia_Rate.technical: When the previous action type is Jump, FGameCharacterAction::ApplyPrevInertia calls SetInertia with this rate/time pair; BlendInertiaFromAction uses the same pair through BlendInertia. FGameShikigamiAction::ApplyPrevInertia mirrors this for shikigami. No EaseOut override is row-driven. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.5.

Jump_Inertia_Time.simple: Inertia duration inherited from a previous Jump action.
Jump_Inertia_Time.technical: Seconds passed as the easing time of SetInertia/BlendInertia in the character and shikigami previous-inertia paths for action type Jump. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.01 (one 0.05 row).

Jump_Inherit_Inertia_Rate.simple: Horizontal inertia multiplier retained when entering Jump.
Jump_Inherit_Inertia_Rate.technical: ScaleInertia multiplies the currently active XY inertia interpolator current value by this rate at JumpBegin::Start, preserving its remaining duration/easing. StartJumpInertiaCarry also uses it when leaving jump mode 28/29 for a fall: it starts FloatInterp6D8 from Rate * FallVerticalSpeed to 0 over the Z/RateZ field when both Rate and Z are positive, otherwise it clears carry. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 1.0 in 48 rows and 1.3 in CP_200.

Jump_Inherit_Inertia_RateZ.simple: Z/inertia-pair parameter retained when entering Jump.
Jump_Inherit_Inertia_RateZ.technical: ScaleInertia multiplies the active Z inertia interpolator current by this value (a ratio, not a time) at JumpBegin::Start. In StartJumpInertiaCarry the same field is instead passed as the FloatInterp6D8 duration in seconds despite its RateZ name. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.01 in 48 rows and 0.8 in CP_180.

Jump_InterpolateTime.simple: Duration of the Jump vertical-speed interpolation.
Jump_InterpolateTime.technical: Seconds. Passed as the time argument of FloatInterp28.Start in character mode 18 and FloatInterp650.Start in character modes 28/29, with a hardcoded EaseOut; shikigami modes 5/21 use the same EaseOut conversion. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.1 in 44 rows, 0.3 in CN_150/CN_160, 0.0 in CP_100/CP_130 and 1.0 in CP_180 (CP_010 is 0.1).

Jump_Minimum_Time.simple: Minimum ground-jump time before queued actions are released.
Jump_Minimum_Time.technical: Seconds. JumpBase::UpdateRequestsGround appends Requests only when Elapsed >= this value; CP_050 inlines the identical test in its slot-90 overrides. The landing request is added separately from Byte16 and the air variant does not apply this gate. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.1 except CN_081, CN_150 and CN_160 at 0.7.

Jump_Overtime.simple: How long a held jump continues to rise.
Jump_Overtime.technical: Seconds. TickJumpVertical keeps extending the FloatInterp28 rise while the Jump key is held and JumpRiseElapsed < this value; releasing the key earlier ends the rise and builds the fall curve, and crossing the threshold splits the step. Shikigami TickJumpVertical has no key check and always uses this Overtime. TickFallStep also reuses it as the FullBodyRotation.Roll lerp rate with -Jump_XY_Speed as target in modes 0x1C/0x1D. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.067 in 46 rows, 0.15 in CP_100/CP_130 and 2.5 in CP_180.

Jump_Rotation_Rate.simple: Steering rate for a normal jump in the air.
Jump_Rotation_Rate.technical: TickAirMove uses Rate * 60.000004 * Step as the LerpRotator alpha toward the input direction (0 snaps). The same row value is passed to TickForwardAirMove/TurnYawToward in mode 0x25 (positive Rate caps yaw change to Rate * Step degrees, <=0 snaps) and to the FullBodyRotation.Roll decay in TickFallStep except in move mode 6, which uses RunJump_InterpolateTime for that decay. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.1 in 47 rows, 5.0 in CP_180 and 0.05 in CN_150.

Jump_Speed_End.simple: Target vertical speed at the end of the Jump rise interpolation.
Jump_Speed_End.technical: World units/s. Used as the FloatInterp28 (and FloatInterp650 where present) To value with the same GetJumpPowerRate() scaling for characters and the raw value for shikigami. It is an interpolation target, not a persistent speed cap; the fall curve is built when the rise ends. C++ default 0.0f; CP_010 exports 1300.

Jump_Speed_Start.simple: Initial vertical speed of the Jump rise.
Jump_Speed_Start.technical: World units/s (cm/s-like). Character SetMoveMode mode 18 starts MoveState.FloatInterp28 from GetJumpPowerRate() * this value and seeds MoveState.VerticalSpeed with the same scaled start; modes 28/29 start FloatInterp650 from the same scaled endpoints without resetting VerticalSpeed. Shikigami mode 5/21 uses the raw value for both roles (no power-rate multiplier); CN_010_JumpAction repeats the raw start/end pair for its shikigami jump. C++ default 0.0f; CP_010 exports 1000.

Jump_XY_Speed.simple: Horizontal air-drift speed for a normal jump.
Jump_XY_Speed.technical: World units/s. TickAirMove sets MoveState speed to this value and moves along nonzero stick input in modes 0x12/0x13, passing through GetMoveSpeed (target distance, camera-relative foreground cone, parallel attack, MoveSpeedRate); shikigami sustain paths use the same value with follow-direction/camera scaling. TickFallStep separately reuses -Jump_XY_Speed as the Roll lerp target in modes 0x1C/0x1D. C++ default 0.0f; exports range 15 (CP_180) to 700 (CP_100/CP_130), CP_010 450.

JumpAir_Blend_Exp.simple: Blend exponent for the JumpAir vertical-speed interpolation.
JumpAir_Blend_Exp.technical: FloatInterp Start BlendExp argument (the easing type is hardcoded EaseOut in these jump presets). C++ default 0.0f; all 49 exports use 2.0.

JumpAir_CancelInput_Time_Min.simple: Earliest time an air jump may be cancelled into.
JumpAir_CancelInput_Time_Min.technical: Seconds. FGameCharacterAction_JumpBase::CanCancelInto refuses JumpAirBegin and RunJumpAirBegin while Elapsed < this value, then defers to the generic cancel table. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.15 in 45 rows, 0.1 in CP_040 and 0.6 in CN_081, CN_150 and CN_160.

JumpAir_Inertia_Rate.simple: Inertia rate inherited from a previous JumpAir action.
JumpAir_Inertia_Rate.technical: When the previous action type is JumpAir, FGameCharacterAction::ApplyPrevInertia calls SetInertia with this rate/time pair; BlendInertiaFromAction uses the same pair through BlendInertia. FGameShikigamiAction::ApplyPrevInertia mirrors this for shikigami. No EaseOut override is row-driven. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.2.

JumpAir_Inertia_Time.simple: Inertia duration inherited from a previous JumpAir action.
JumpAir_Inertia_Time.technical: Seconds passed as the easing time of SetInertia/BlendInertia in the character and shikigami previous-inertia paths for action type JumpAir. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.2.

JumpAir_Inherit_Inertia_Rate.simple: Horizontal inertia multiplier retained when entering JumpAir.
JumpAir_Inherit_Inertia_Rate.technical: ScaleInertia multiplies the currently active XY inertia interpolator current value by this rate at JumpAirBegin::Start, preserving its remaining duration/easing No StartJumpInertiaCarry case exists for this family, so the carry path does not use it. C++ default 0.0f; all 49 exports use 1.0.

JumpAir_InterpolateTime.technical: Seconds. Passed as the time argument of FloatInterp28.Start in character mode 24 and shikigami mode 13, with a hardcoded EaseOut; no FloatInterp650 consumer uses this field. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.1 in 45 rows, 0.3 in CN_150/CN_160 and 0.0 in CP_100/CP_130 (CP_010 is 0.1).

JumpAir_Overtime.simple: How long a held air jump continues to rise.
JumpAir_Overtime.technical: Seconds; TickJumpVertical uses it for character mode 0x18 and shikigami modes 13 and 21. The CN_010 jump action enters mode 21, whose rise uses this Overtime but whose sustain uses DashJump_XY_Speed/DashJump_Rotation_Speed. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.067 in 47 rows and 0.215 in two rows.

Shikigami mode 13 uses the raw value for both roles (no power-rate multiplier). C++ default 0.0f; CP_010 exports 1350.

JumpAir_XY_Speed.simple: Horizontal air-drift speed for an air jump.
JumpAir_XY_Speed.technical: World units/s used by TickAirMove for character modes 0x18/0x19 and by shikigami mode 13/14 sustain, with the same GetMoveSpeed scaling as Jump_XY_Speed. C++ default 0.0f; exports range 250-800, CP_010 450.

Rigidity_DashJumpBegin.simple: Rigidity category used for the DashJumpBegin begin animation rate.
Rigidity_DashJumpBegin.technical: EGameActionRigidityType stored as a row enum, converted by Status_RigidityIndex to enum value - 1 and used to index GlobalCorrect.Rigidity_DashJumpBegin; out-of-range indices (including None -> -1) return 1.0f. The resulting rate is forwarded by GetDashJumpBeginRigidityRate to DashJumpBegin::GetBeginRigidityRate and passed as the PlayAnimation rate at GameCharacterAction_Jump.cpp:28. C++ constructor default None; exports use Light/Normal/Heavy (27 Normal, 17 Light, 5 Heavy across these fields).

RunJumpAir_Blend_Exp.technical: FloatInterp Start BlendExp argument (the easing type is hardcoded EaseOut in these jump presets). C++ default 0.0f; all 49 exports use 2.0.

RunJumpAir_Inertia_Rate.simple: Inertia rate inherited from a previous RunJumpAir action.
RunJumpAir_Inertia_Rate.technical: When the previous action type is RunJumpAir, FGameCharacterAction::ApplyPrevInertia calls SetInertia with this rate/time pair; BlendInertiaFromAction uses the same pair through BlendInertia. FGameShikigamiAction::ApplyPrevInertia mirrors this for shikigami. No EaseOut override is row-driven. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.8.

RunJumpAir_Inertia_Time.simple: Inertia duration inherited from a previous RunJumpAir action.
RunJumpAir_Inertia_Time.technical: Seconds passed as the easing time of SetInertia/BlendInertia in the character and shikigami previous-inertia paths for action type RunJumpAir. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.1.

RunJumpAir_Inherit_Inertia_Rate.simple: Horizontal inertia multiplier retained when entering RunJumpAir.
RunJumpAir_Inherit_Inertia_Rate.technical: ScaleInertia multiplies the currently active XY inertia interpolator current value by this rate at RunJumpAirBegin::Start, preserving its remaining duration/easing No StartJumpInertiaCarry case exists for this family, so the carry path does not use it. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 1.0 in 48 rows and 0.85 in CP_200.

RunJumpAir_Inherit_Inertia_RateZ.simple: Z/inertia-pair parameter retained when entering RunJumpAir.
RunJumpAir_Inherit_Inertia_RateZ.technical: ScaleInertia multiplies the active Z inertia interpolator current by this value (a ratio, not a time) at RunJumpAirBegin::Start. No StartJumpInertiaCarry case exists for this family. C++ default 0.0f; all 49 exports use 0.01.

RunJumpAir_InterpolateTime.simple: Duration of the RunJumpAir vertical-speed interpolation.
RunJumpAir_InterpolateTime.technical: Seconds. Passed as the time argument of FloatInterp28.Start in character mode 26 and shikigami mode 15, with a hardcoded EaseOut; no FloatInterp650 consumer uses this field. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.1 in 45 rows, 0.3 in CN_150/CN_160 and 0.0 in CP_100/CP_130 (CP_010 is 0.1).

RunJumpAir_Overtime.simple: How long a held running air jump continues to rise.
RunJumpAir_Overtime.technical: Seconds; TickJumpVertical uses it for character mode 0x1A and shikigami mode 15. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 0.067 in 47 rows and 0.12 in two rows.

RunJumpAir_Rotation_Speed.simple: Yaw turn-rate cap for a running air jump.
RunJumpAir_Rotation_Speed.technical: Degrees/s passed through TickForwardAirMove/TurnYawToward for character modes 0x1A/0x1B and shikigami mode 15/16 sustain; <=0 snaps. C++ default 0.0f; exports are 400 in 44 rows, 250 in two, 300 in two and 700 in one.

RunJumpAir_Speed_End.simple: Target vertical speed at the end of the RunJumpAir rise interpolation.
RunJumpAir_Speed_End.technical: World units/s. Used as the FloatInterp28 (and FloatInterp650 where present) To value with the same GetJumpPowerRate() scaling for characters and the raw value for shikigami. It is an interpolation target, not a persistent speed cap; the fall curve is built when the rise ends. C++ default 0.0f; CP_010 exports 1000.

RunJumpAir_Speed_Start.simple: Initial vertical speed of the RunJumpAir rise.
RunJumpAir_Speed_Start.technical: World units/s (cm/s-like). Character SetMoveMode mode 26 starts MoveState.FloatInterp28 from GetJumpPowerRate() * this value and seeds MoveState.VerticalSpeed with the same scaled start. Shikigami mode 15 uses the raw value for both roles (no power-rate multiplier). C++ default 0.0f; CP_010 exports 1350.

RunJumpAir_XY_Speed.simple: Horizontal air speed for a running air jump.
RunJumpAir_XY_Speed.technical: World units/s used by TickForwardAirMove in character modes 0x1A/0x1B and by shikigami mode 15/16 sustain, with GetMoveSpeed scaling. C++ default 0.0f; exports range 500-1000, CP_010 725.

notes: Runtime descriptions are based on the reconstructed Abrams and AbramsDataTable source. Exported value counts come from the available DataTable shards.

Five exported assets (ActionJumpDataTable1..5) are loaded into one ActionJumpDataTables cache; they hold 49 unique row keys with no repeats. The export key is ID while the native USTRUCT property is Id; consumers use it as a FindRow key, not as a separately read value field.

Character rows are selected indirectly: ResolveDataRows uses the setup's ActionIdOverride (when non-None) to select the ActionDataTable row, reads that row's Id_ActionJump, and caches the jump row at AGameCharacter.ActionJumpRow +0x3F8; a miss fails ResolveDataRows. Shikigami rows come from ShikigamiDataTable.Id_ActionJump via CharacterShikigamiDataTable.Id_Shikigami, and are skipped when the Id is None; a failed non-None lookup returns false without replacing the cached JumpRow.

All 49 exported keys are referenced: ActionDataTable rows alias CP_010 six times; ShikigamiDataTable rows alias CN_010 fourteen times. Neither alias duplicates a row key in this table, so the sharing happens at the referencing tables.

C++ row defaults are 0.0f for every numeric member and EGameEasingType::None / EGameActionRigidityType::None for enums; the exports supply the populated values mentioned per field. Export values are observations only and are not claimed as retail behaviour.

Speed fields are world units/s, times and Overtime values are seconds, gravity is a positive magnitude subtracted in BuildFallCurve, and TurnYawToward RotationSpeed values are degrees/s caps. Jump_Rotation_Rate/JumpAir_Rotation_Rate instead act as frame-scaled LerpRotator alphas (Rate * 60.000004 * Step) in TickAirMove.

Naming traps: Inherit_Inertia_RateZ scales the active Z inertia interpolator in ScaleInertia but is used as a FloatInterp6D8 duration when StartJumpInertiaCarry leaves jump modes 28/29/30 for a fall. Fall_XY_Speed is both the fall drift speed and the MaxFallSpeed argument on the character SetMoveMode fall transition. A zero Fall_Gravity leaves the sampled curve at its starting speed. RunJump_Speed_Start/End and Jump_Overtime/Jump_XY_Speed are reused as FullBodyRotation.Roll lerp parameters in TickFallStep; its decay factor is Jump_Rotation_Rate except in mode 6, which uses RunJump_InterpolateTime.

Rigidity_JumpAirBegin is also read by RunJumpAirBegin::GetBeginRigidityRate; there is no separate RunJumpAir rigidity field. GlobalCorrect arrays in the exported default row are [0.8,0.7,0.6] for JumpBegin/RunJumpBegin and [0.75,0.7,0.65] for DashJumpBegin; index 0=Light, 1=Normal, 2=Heavy and None/out-of-range values fall back to 1.0.

Shikigami presets call FloatInterp28.Start with raw row speeds, while character SETMOVE_START_JUMP multiplies both endpoints by GetJumpPowerRate(). Shikigami TickJumpVertical has no held-Jump key test and no GetFallGravityRate() multiplier, unlike the character jump path.

No field-specific consumer was found outside Source/Abrams and Source/AbramsDataTable; indirect modifiers such as buff-derived JumpPowerRate/FallGravityRate, target/camera slowdowns and ActionIdOverride are described where they apply but are owned by other tables/systems.

usages.detail: Resolves and registers all five ActionJumpDataTableN assets into the single ActionJumpDataTables array; names are also registered at lines 375-379.
ResolveDataRows finds Action->Id_ActionJump in ActionJumpDataTables and caches it in ActionJumpRow; failure fails character row resolution.
ResolveRows finds the jump row from ShikigamiDataTable.Id_ActionJump when non-None and caches it as JumpRow.
GetActionJumpRow exposes the cached row at +0x3F8 to actions, controllers and status code.
ApplyPrevInertia switches on the previous action type and calls SetInertia with the matching Jump/RunJump/DashJump/JumpAir/RunJumpAir/BounceUp Inertia_Rate/Time pair.
BlendInertiaFromAction repeats the same row-driven inertia selection with BlendInertia.
Each jump Begin action calls ScaleInertia with its Inherit_Inertia_Rate and Inherit_Inertia_RateZ fields.
ScaleInertia multiplies active XY/Z inertia interpolator currents by the two inherit rates while preserving remaining time and easing.
StartJumpInertiaCarry uses Inherit_Inertia_Rate * FallVerticalSpeed as the start of FloatInterp6D8 and Inherit_Inertia_RateZ as its duration when leaving jump modes for a fall.
SETMOVE_START_JUMP scales both speed endpoints by GetJumpPowerRate and starts FloatInterp28 with hardcoded EaseOut and the row Blend_Exp.
Fall entry sets VerticalSpeed = -Fall_Speed_Start and builds the fall curve with Fall_Gravity.
SetMoveMode maps modes 18/20/22/24/26 to the Jump/RunJump/DashJump/JumpAir/RunJumpAir speed preset quartets.
TickFallStep reuses Jump_Overtime/Jump_XY_Speed and RunJump_Speed_Start/End as FullBodyRotation.Roll lerp parameters; mode 0x1C/0x1D and 0x1E are special cases.
Per-mode rise/fall ticks feed Fall_Gravity, family Overtime, XY_Speed and Rotation fields into TickJumpVertical/TickAirMove/TickForwardAirMove.
TickJumpVertical ends the held-key rise at Overtime or early key release, then samples the fall curve built from Fall_Gravity.
TickAirMove applies XY_Speed to stick input and uses RotationRate * 60.000004 * Step as the rotation lerp alpha after GetMoveSpeed scaling.
TickModeFall uses Fall_XY_Speed for input drift, Fall_Rotation_Speed for yaw turning, and samples the gravity curve.
RestartFall resets to -Fall_Speed_Start and rebuilds the fall curve with Fall_Gravity.
Status_RigidityRate converts the row rigidity enum to a GlobalCorrect array index, returning 1.0f when out of range.
Jump-Begin Start plays its animation with GetBeginRigidityRate() as the animation rate.
JumpBase::CanCancelInto blocks both air-jump Begin types before JumpAir_CancelInput_Time_Min elapses.
Ground jump requests are appended only after Jump_Minimum_Time; CP_050 inlines the same body at line 290.
Shikigami SetMoveMode starts jump-family FloatInterp28 with raw row speeds and seeds VerticalSpeed from the start value.
Shikigami TickJumpVertical uses row Overtime without a held-key check and builds the fall curve from the raw row gravity.
Shikigami sustain routes family XY_Speed/Rotation fields through TickJumpAirMove and owner-follow direction.
Follow-fall uses Fall_Gravity, Fall_XY_Speed and Fall_Rotation_Speed from the resolved shikigami jump row.
CN_010_JumpAction starts its shikigami jump directly from Jump_Speed_Start/End/InterpolateTime/Blend_Exp.
Shikigami ApplyPrevInertia selects the same jump-family inertia rate/time pairs from JumpRow.
BounceUp::Start enters move mode 36, which consumes the BounceUp_Speed_* and BounceUp_XY_Speed_* fields.
Reconstructed constructor supplies the 0.0f/None defaults noted in field descriptions.
